subject: Request: Meridian renewal concession — executive authorization needed
messages:
From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@meridianhealth.org>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Matt Jensen <matt.jensen@meridianhealth.org>
Date: Sat, 1 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal proposal and concession request

David —

Thanks for the renewal draft. We reviewed the numbers internally and Meridian is under pressure to reduce recurring spend this year. We can sign for another 12 months but only if we get a one-time credit or larger first-year discount to offset an upcoming budget cut.

Specific ask: 30% discount on list for year one OR a one-time credit of $200,000 applied at invoice. We also want a 12-month term reset (start fresh on signature date) and an SLA add-on guaranteeing 99.95% uptime for mission-critical endpoints.

Attached are the redlined terms from Procurement (see Merid_Renewal_Terms_v3.pdf and SOW). Can you let us know if Redwood can accommodate any of this? We need a decision by EOD Thursday 8/5 to hit our board procurement window.

Appreciate it —
Sarah Miller
VP Procurement, Meridian Health

--
Meridian Health
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal proposal and concession request — Meridian (need exec OK)

Team — forwarding Meridian's ask. Key points summarized below and my recommended approval band. Need an exec signoff or guidance by EOD Wed 8/4 so I can respond before their 8/5 deadline.

Customer request (summary):
- Either 30% first-year discount OR $200k one-time credit
- 12-month term reset to align with their fiscal year
- SLA: 99.95% for mission-critical endpoints (they want this written into SOW)

Impact and options: 
A) Approve full ask: $200k credit + SLA add-on (fast win but big discounting; finance & legal review required)
B) Compromise: $150k credit OR 20% discount; SLA add-on for 6 months with performance review at 6m
C) Minimal: 12-month term reset only, no material credit; offer service credits for SLA breaches instead of higher SLA guarantee

My recommendation: option B (middle ground). Meridian is strategic in our NE health cluster; losing them would impact a few upcoming references. If we go with B, I'd like authority to offer up to $175k credit and up to 18% discount as a final offer — anything above $175k needs CC to finance and executive committee. Legal will need to approve SLA language but we can draft a limited 6-month elevated SLA.

Attachments: Meridian_Renewal_Terms_v3.pdf (redlines), SOW_redline.docx

Please reply with APPROVE / ADJUST / ESCALATE and any caps.

Thanks,
David
David Kim
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 13:35:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal and concession request — Meridian (need exec OK)

David / Vivek / Laura —

I reviewed the book of business and Meridian's usage trend. They're steady, but not growing much — commodity risk is real. I support a compromise approach. My suggested final structure:
- One-time credit: $150,000 applied on first renewal invoice
- 18% first-year discount OR credit (customer can choose)
- 12-month term reset
- SLA: provide 99.95% as a beta add-on for 6 months with explicit KPIs and a remediation fence (service credits capped at $25k)

Rationale: $150k plus SLA beta is persuasive and keeps total concession within a tolerable range for renewals. If Finance won't sign off, escalate.

Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Renewal proposal and concession request — Meridian (need exec OK)

Team —

Thanks for the clear options. Two operational notes before signoff:
1) Anything above $175k total concession needs FP&A approval given our margins on this deal and precedent risk.
2) SLA commitment: legal needs to scope the elevated SLA very tightly (specific endpoints, change control, and a force-majeure carve-out). We should not offer an open 99.95% global SLA without those guardrails.

With that, I authorize: up to $175k one-time credit OR up to 18% first-year discount, plus a 6-month SLA beta with a $25k credit cap. Approve within those bounds and proceed. If David wants to push past that, escalate to CFO/Deal Committee and route to finance.

- Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales Operations and Strategy
Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@meridianhealth.org>, Meridian Procurement <procure@meridianhealth.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 17:22:00 -0400
Subject: Approved concession offer — Meridian renewal (final)

Sarah / Team —

Thanks for your patience. Redwood can approve a one-time concession to preserve the relationship. Final offer below (approved by our leadership team):

Final offer (pick one):
- Option 1: $175,000 one-time credit applied to first renewal invoice; 12-month term reset; 6-month elevated SLA (99.95%) with $25k maximum remediation credit
- Option 2: 18% first-year discount (in lieu of credit); 12-month term reset; same SLA beta as above

Next steps:
1) Please confirm which option Meridian prefers by Thursday 8/6 EOD.
2) If confirmed, we'll send a DocuSign for the revised order form and a short SLA appendix for legal review.
3) Links: HubSpot deal record: https://hubspot.com/deals/DEAL-2026-0397 ; DocuSign preview: https://app.docusign.com/meridian/renewal-v3

Attachments: Meridian_Renewal_Terms_v3.pdf (final redlines)

David
David Kim
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
